attempts.why: Scoping all dropdown summary selectors to direct children prevents nested accordion summaries inside the dropdown menu from inheriting the dropdown button styling.

selfVerify.reason: Nested 'Solid (accordion)' summary inside the open dropdown shows no dropdown box/border/background, only plain text with its own right chevron, while the top dropdown retains its bordered button and down chevron.

pick.suspected: The dropdown's summary styling uses a descendant selector, so the nested accordion's summary inside the dropdown menu incorrectly inherits the dropdown button box/border/chevron styling.
